narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for the Dyson BP04 air purifier, specifically targeting pet owners during the Double 11 (11/11) shopping festival. It uses the narrative of a man being forced to throw away his perfume due to his cat's sensitivity to frame the purifier as an essential home appliance for maintaining air quality and harmony in a pet-friendly household.
